issue_context.summary: A second-hand report says the installed Miro PWA does not appear in PowerToys Run Window Walker results, while two other Edge PWAs were tested successfully and the original behavior was never reproduced by the issue author.
known_information: The Program plugin returns Miro, but Window Walker reportedly does not show the running instance.
Other Edge PWAs appeared correctly in Window Walker.
inferences: The Miro PWA title may not contain “Miro,” or its browser-hosted window identity may differ from the tested PWAs.
issue_context.analysis: A screenshot plus window title/process is more useful than a bugreport here because it distinguishes search-token mismatch from enumeration failure.

actions.label: Request current Miro PWA identity details

comment.body:
The original report was second-hand, and two other Edge PWAs were successfully found, so the missing discriminator is Miro’s current window identity. Could you please provide:
- The current PowerToys version, browser/version, and how Miro was installed as a PWA.
- A screenshot showing the running Miro window title and Window Walker results when searching both `Miro` and a distinctive word from that title.
- Whether Miro appears in Alt+Tab and Task Manager, including the process name shown there.
This will show whether Window Walker is failing to enumerate the PWA or whether the query has no title/process text to match.

title: PWA apps not showing up in running process result
